concept: A large, fractured map of North America split down the middle, with the US and Canada visibly separating. The crack radiates outward like shattered glass. The background shows a burning shopping mall, a monastery in ruins, and a child's silhouette alone on a mountain slope, all contained in ghostly smaller vignettes around the central break. Dark storm clouds loom overhead. Style: stark, bold geometric forms with heavy shadows, resembling a cracked political map rendered in thick brushstrokes and harsh contrasts.
explanation: Today's news is dominated by fragmentation—political rupture between allies, violent strikes destroying civilian spaces, reckless abandonment, and deepening geopolitical hostility. The collapsing Canada-US trade talks symbolize the broader fracturing of international order visible across Ukraine, Syria, Israel, Myanmar, and domestic tensions in the US. The smaller vignettes represent the human cost scattered beneath these large-scale collapses: loss of life, child endangerment, institutional breakdown.

headlines.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
headlines.summary: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.

headlines.title: Carney faces crucial test after walking away from Trump's deal
headlines.summary: The Canadian prime minister will have to sell his gamble that walking away from talks with the White House will be worth the consequences.

headlines.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
headlines.summary: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

headlines.title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike
headlines.summary: The man had taken his two boys on the trip but is said to have left one behind when he got tired.

headlines.title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
headlines.summary: The latest incident comes days after reports emerged Israel had struck a military airbase close to the Turkish border.

headlines.title: 'We're not going to run from it': Sydney Marathon laughs off medal error
headlines.summary: Runners will receive a medal at the 2026 Sydney Marathon with an engraving of a German stadium.

headlines.title: Girl, 17, killed in Swedish sword attack, police say
headlines.summary: Two boys aged 12 and 17 were also injured, while an 18-year-old suspect has been detained.

headlines.title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
headlines.summary: A rescue worker said the site had been struck twice as civilians gathered for a meditation retreat.

headlines.title: Laptop catches fire on US flight, with passenger treated at airport
headlines.summary: The pilot had reported a "cabin fire in the back" of American Airlines Flight 2398, which landed safely.

headlines.title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
headlines.summary: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

headlines.title: US military newspaper editor voices censorship fears after being fired
headlines.summary: Erik Slavin believes he was fired for saying in an interview that "in a hypothetical situation, censorship would be a red line".

headlines.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
headlines.summary: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.
